<mujoco model="spring_length">
  <option timestep="0.002"/>
  <compiler angle="radian"/>
  <worldbody>
    <site name="w0" pos="0.3 0 1.2"/>
    <body name="u" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h1" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" ref="0.8" springref="-0.3" damping="0.2"/>
      <geom type="box" size="0.02 0.02 0.25" pos="0 0 -0.25" mass="1"/>
      <site name="u1" pos="0.04 0 -0.1"/>
      <site name="u2" pos="0.04 0 -0.45"/>
      <body name="l" pos="0 0 -0.5">
        <joint name="h2" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" ref="-0.5" damping="0.2"/>
        <geom type="box" size="0.02 0.02 0.2" pos="0 0 -0.2" mass="0.5"/>
        <site name="l1" pos="0.03 0 -0.2"/>
        <body name="s" pos="0 0 -0.4">
          <joint name="sl" type="slide" axis="1 0 0" ref="0.05" springref="0.12" damping="0.5"/>
          <geom type="sphere" size="0.03" mass="0.2"/>
          <site name="s1" pos="0 0.02 0"/>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <tendon>
    <spatial name="t_auto" stiffness="30" damping="1">
      <site site="w0"/>
      <site site="u1"/>
      <site site="u2"/>
      <site site="l1"/>
      <site site="s1"/>
    </spatial>
    <spatial name="t_given" stiffness="20" springlength="0.4">
      <site site="u1"/>
      <site site="s1"/>
    </spatial>
    <fixed name="t_fixed" stiffness="5">
      <joint joint="h1" coef="1"/>
      <joint joint="sl" coef="2"/>
    </fixed>
  </tendon>
</mujoco>

<mujoco model="spatial-path">
  <option gravity="0 0 -9.81" timestep="0.002"/>
  <compiler angle="radian"/>

  <worldbody>
    <body name="upper" pos="0 0 1.0">
      <joint name="shoulder" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.3" ref="0.8"/>
      <geom name="upper_geom" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 -0.5"
            size="0.03" mass="1.0" rgba="0.55 0.55 0.65 1"/>
      <site name="s_origin" pos="0.035 0 -0.05" size="0.012"
            rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
      <site name="s_mid" pos="0.035 0 -0.45" size="0.012"
            rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
      <body name="lower" pos="0 0 -0.5">
        <joint name="elbow" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.3" ref="-0.5"/>
        <geom name="lower_geom" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 -0.4"
              size="0.025" mass="0.5" rgba="0.45 0.45 0.55 1"/>
        <site name="s_insert" pos="0.03 0 -0.2" size="0.012"
              rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <tendon>
    <spatial name="path" stiffness="30" damping="1">
      <site site="s_origin"/>
      <site site="s_mid"/>
      <site site="s_insert"/>
    </spatial>
  </tendon>

  <sensor>
    <tendonpos name="ten_pos" tendon="path"/>
    <tendonvel name="ten_vel" tendon="path"/>
  </sensor>
</mujoco>

tendon_limits.xml:
<mujoco model="tendon-limits">
  <option gravity="0 0 -4.0" timestep="0.002"/>
  <compiler angle="degree"/>

  <worldbody>
    <!-- Fixed anchor: above and right of the pivot. The pendulum swings
         below the pivot so the arm never passes through the anchor. -->
    <body name="anchor_body" pos="0.2 0 1.3">
      <geom name="anchor_geom" type="sphere" size="0.02"
            rgba="0.85 0.25 0.2 1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
      <site name="anchor" pos="0 0 0" size="0.012" rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- Pendulum: starts tilted toward the anchor (short tendon) -->
    <body name="pivot" pos="0 0 1.2">
      <joint name="hinge" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.01"
             ref="-90"/>
      <geom name="rod" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 -0.5"
            size="0.02" mass="0.3" rgba="0.3 0.5 0.85 1"/>
      <body name="tip" pos="0 0 -0.5">
        <geom name="ball" type="sphere" size="0.04" mass="0.5"
              rgba="0.3 0.5 0.85 1"/>
        <site name="tip_site" pos="0 0 0" size="0.012" rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <tendon>
    <spatial name="tether" limited="true" range="0.0 0.65">
      <site site="anchor"/>
      <site site="tip_site"/>
    </spatial>
  </tendon>

  <sensor>
    <tendonpos name="ten_pos" tendon="tether"/>
    <tendonlimitfrc name="ten_lf" tendon="tether"/>
  </sensor>
</mujoco>

<mujoco model="sphere-wrap">
  <option gravity="0 0 0" timestep="0.002"/>
  <compiler angle="radian"/>

  <worldbody>
    <!-- Wrap sphere (translucent, no collision) -->
    <body name="wrap_body" pos="0 0 0.8">
      <geom name="wrap_sphere" type="sphere" size="0.1"
            rgba="0.9 0.85 0.2 0.3" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
      <!-- Sidesite above the sphere — disambiguates which side to wrap on -->
      <site name="side" pos="0 0 0.12" size="0.005"/>
    </body>

    <!-- Rotating arm with origin site on the tip -->
    <body name="arm" pos="0 0 0.8">
      <joint name="j1" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="5.0"/>
      <geom name="arm_geom" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0"
            size="0.02" mass="0.5" rgba="0.3 0.5 0.85 1"/>
      <site name="s_origin" pos="0.2 0 0" size="0.012" rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- Fixed anchor on the opposite side -->
    <body name="anchor" pos="-0.2 0 0.8">
      <geom name="anchor_geom" type="sphere" size="0.015"
            rgba="0.85 0.25 0.2 1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
      <site name="s_insert" pos="0 0 0" size="0.012" rgba="1 1 0 1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <tendon>
    <spatial name="wrap_tendon">
      <site site="s_origin"/>
      <geom geom="wrap_sphere" sidesite="side"/>
      <site site="s_insert"/>
    </spatial>
  </tendon>

  <actuator>
    <motor name="drive" joint="j1" gear="1"/>
  </actuator>

  <sensor>
    <tendonpos name="ten_pos" tendon="wrap_tendon"/>
    <tendonvel name="ten_vel" tendon="wrap_tendon"/>
  </sensor>
</mujoco>

  <option timestep="0.002" jacobian="sparse"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="b1"><joint name="a" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1"/><geom type="capsule" size="0.03" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" mass="1"/>
    <body name="b2" pos="0.3 0 0"><joint name="b" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1"/><geom type="capsule" size="0.03" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" mass="1"/>
    </body></body>
  </worldbody>
  <tendon>
    <fixed name="t" stiffness="0.5" damping="0.1" springlength="0.1">
      <joint joint="a" coef="1"/><joint joint="b" coef="0.5"/><joint joint="a" coef="2"/>
    </fixed>
  </tendon>
  <actuator><motor tendon="t"/></actuator>
</mujoco>

<mujoco model="tendon_motors">
  <option gravity="0 0 0"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="a" pos="-0.25 0.05 0.02"><joint name="ja" type="hinge" axis="0 0 1"/><joint name="ja2" type="slide" axis="0.3 1 0.2"/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.01" mass="0.1"/><site name="a0" pos="0.02 0.01 0"/></body>
    <body name="b" pos="0.25 -0.03 -0.01"><joint name="jb" type="ball"/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.01" mass="0.1"/><site name="b0" pos="0.01 -0.02 0.03"/>
      <body pos="0.1 0 0"><joint name="jc" type="hinge" axis="0.3 1 0.2"/><geom type="sphere" size="0.01" mass="0.1"/>
        <site name="c0" pos="0.03 0.01 0"/></body></body>
  </worldbody>
  <tendon>
    <spatial name="s"><site site="a0"/><site site="b0"/><site site="c0"/></spatial>
    <fixed name="f"><joint joint="ja" coef="0.37"/><joint joint="ja2" coef="-1.13"/><joint joint="jc" coef="0.71"/></fixed>
  </tendon>
  <actuator><motor tendon="s" gear="1.37"/><motor tendon="f" gear="-2.71"/></actuator>
</mujoco>
